verdict.rationale: Loops says an agent can create draft campaigns, content and all, straight from the API, and a human then reviews and sends from the dashboard. That matches the draft-then-approve pattern, and the API intro confirms campaign creation and management. Campaigns target segments of contacts, but the docs never explicitly say an API-created draft can be assigned to a segment. missing for 10: explicit evidence that an API draft can target a segment, a scheduled/queued state or formal approval step, campaign tools in the MCP server (it lists only contacts, events and transactional email), independent hands-on corroboration.
